LanguageData.FastFire_Mode_ExtremeGridDesc: Simulates static ground fires in compact dense arrays and materializes proxy Fire things on demand only when pawns or AI target them; pawn-attached fires remain vanilla. Fastest TPS, lowest memory, and instant mass-extinguish.
LanguageData.FastFire_Mode_CompatibleDesc: Keeps real Fire Thing instances across the map for maximum compatibility with heavily modded fire behaviors while decoupling lighting, rendering, pathing, audio, and TickList overhead.
LanguageData.FastFire_Mode_VanillaDesc: Temporarily disables optimizations to restore vanilla behavior so you can directly compare TPS/FPS on the same burning map.
LanguageData.FastFire_EnableClusterLightingDesc: Merges individual fire CompGlowers into 4x4 chunk glowers, eliminating GlowGrid combine storms and constant lighting mesh rebuilds.
LanguageData.FastFire_EnableBatchedRendering: Batched Fire Rendering & Glow Fleck Throttling
LanguageData.FastFire_EnableBatchedRenderingDesc: Bypasses DynamicDrawManager with camera-culled instanced/batched drawing and throttles excess FireGlow flecks when fire counts are high.
LanguageData.FastFire_EnablePathingDebounceDesc: Replaces 9-neighbor thing-list scans with an O(1) fire danger bitmap and batches PathFinder updates every 15 ticks.
LanguageData.FastFire_EnableAudioAggregationDesc: Maintains at most 4 aggregated fire sustainers near the camera instead of ticking and summing 10,000 reporters every frame.
LanguageData.FastFire_EnableAiSpatialAccelDesc: Uses chunk density counters for animal fleeing, home-area alerts, fire watcher, and firefighting; skips snow radial scans when snow-free and caches static flammability.
